title.narrative: Karnataka Integrated Urban Water Management Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative: Project 1 is representative of subprojects to be financed under the investment program. Under output 1, project 1 will finance Urban Water Supply and Sanitation (UWSS) infrastructure in three towns of the Tungabhadra subbasin: Byadagi, Davangere, and Harihar.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Improved water resources management in selected urban areas of the Upper Tunga Bhadra subbasin

• Households additionally served with sewers in target ULBs including the poor, females and socially excluded households (Target: additional 60,000 HH; baseline: 36,000 HH) Progress/Status: Work has been completed and 19,842 connections has been provided in Byadgi, Harihara and Davangere. House service connections are still in progress. Data Source: • PPMS, KUIDFC, ULB reports, and ULB statistics Actual value:

• Improved water use efficiency through NRW reduction from average 40% (in 2012) to less than 25% in Byadgi, Davangere, and Harihara Progress/Status: Water Supply works in Byadgi, davangere and Harihara are being done through 6 contracts (Bulk watre:3, Distribution:3). Bulk Water Supply contract of all the three towns has been completed. Distribution work contract of Harihara have been completed. Distribution work contract of Davangere and Byadgi are under implementation. NRW will be measured after completion of all the contracts. Data Source: • KUIDFC and KMRC annual reports and ULB statistics Actual value:

• Additional households served with new piped, metered water connections in target ULBs including the poor, females, and socially excluded HH (Target: additional 52,000 HH; baseline: 52,000 HH) Progress/Status: Connection of Households with new piped, metered water is in progress in all the three towns and 83,314 connections have already being provided in Byadgi, Harihara and Davangere. Data Source: • PPMS, KUIDFC, ULB reports, and ULB statistics Actual value:

• National wastewater effluent quality discharge/reuse standards met in Byadgi, Davangere, and Harihara (baseline, 2013: Davangere Zone 1, non-compliant; Harihar, partially compliant; Byadgi did not have operational STPs in 2013 Progress/Status: National wastewater effluent quality discharge standards will be met in Byadgi, Harihara and Davangere once the STPs are operational and all the households are connected with the sewer network. Data Source: • KSPCB and ULB reports Base year: 2013 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Expanded and upgraded UWSS infrastructure in three towns of the Upper Tunga Bhadra subbasin Indicator: • 50% effluent recycled for agricultural or industrial purposes Progress/Status: Davangere: 50% effluent of the STP is reused for agricultural purpose. Harihara and Byadgi STPs are under trial run , once operationalized, target of recycling 50% effluent for agricultural and industrial process would be achieved. Data Source: • PPMS, KUIDFC, and ULB reports Actual value:

Output: Expanded and upgraded UWSS infrastructure in three towns of the Upper Tunga Bhadra subbasin Indicator: • Output-based toilets and connection program for poor and vulnerable households (target: 5,000 new toilets reaching pop. 30,000, including FHH) Progress/Status: Acheived. %,474 individula toilets and 57 school toilets have been constructed under the grant. Data Source: • PPMS and NGO reports Actual value:

Output: Expanded and upgraded UWSS infrastructure in three towns of the Upper Tunga Bhadra subbasin Indicator: • Water supplied meets national standards (Target: 95% of tests; baseline: non-compliant) Progress/Status: The target of supplied water meeting national standard will be completed when the water treatment plants will be operationalized. Harihara water Treatment plant has been operationalized and is meeting national standards. Davangere water treatment plant is under progress. Data Source: • ULB reports Actual value:

Output: Improved water resource planning, monitoring, and service delivery Indicator: 2.1 ULB Incentive Fund established and piloted • Water audits for four new ULBs developed Progress/Status: ULB Incentive Fund have been established and NRW baseline audit has been completed in all 4 towns Harihara, Byadgi, Davangere and Renebennur. Data Source: • PPMS and ULB reports Actual value:

Output: Improved water resource planning, monitoring, and service delivery Indicator: • Customer database in four ULBs updated Progress/Status: Customer database is being regularly updated in all the 4 project towns. Data Source: • PPMS and ULB reports Actual value:

Output: Improved water resource planning, monitoring, and service delivery Indicator: • Water asset mapping and condition assessments for two new ULBs conducted Progress/Status: Mapping of existing assets & assets being created under the project is being done in all the 4 towns regularly. Data Source: • PPMS and ULB reports Actual value:

Output: Strengthened operational and administrative capacity of KUIDFC and ULBs Indicator: 3.2 Improved ULB administrative capacity building • Capacity development programs developed and tested with water sector staff of target ULBs in Tranche 1 towns (target: >75 officials, of which 33% women) Progress/Status: 3.2(a) Capacity development programs are being developed and trainings are being imparted. Data Source: • PPMS and training materials Actual value:

Output: Expanded and upgraded UWSS infrastructure in three towns of the Upper Tunga Bhadra subbasin Indicator: 1.1 Inefficient water supply systems rehabilitated and upgraded • Average hours of water supply extended from 1 hour daily (average) to continuous 24x7 supply in project 1 ULBS Progress/Status: Work of rehabilitation and upgradation of water supply system is completed in Harihara and is under progress in Byadgi and Davangere. The target of continuous 24*7 water supply will be fully achieved after completion of all water supply related subprojects in the project towns. Data Source: • ULB statistics and census data Actual value:

Output: Expanded and upgraded UWSS infrastructure in three towns of the Upper Tunga Bhadra subbasin Indicator: • Water production and treatment capacity increased (additional 15,000m3/day; baseline: 108,000m3/day) Progress/Status: Water Treatment Plant of 40 MLD is nearing completion in Davangere and 20 MLD is comminsioned in Harihar. Target of increasing water production and treatment capacity will be met when both the DavanagereWTP will be operationalized. Data Source: • PPMS, KUIDFC, and ULB reports Actual value:

Output: Expanded and upgraded UWSS infrastructure in three towns of the Upper Tunga Bhadra subbasin Indicator: • Sewers extended (additional 365km; baseline: 500km) Progress/Status: The work of laying sewer lines in Byadgi, Harihara and Davangere are nearing completion in all respect. and 345.44 km sewer pipeline has been laid till now. Data Source: • PPMS, KUIDFC, and ULB reports Actual value:

Output: Expanded and upgraded UWSS infrastructure in three towns of the Upper Tunga Bhadra subbasin Indicator: 1.2 Wastewater networks, treatment and effluent reuse infrastructure expanded • Wastewater capacity increased (additional 48,000m3/day; baseline: 54,000m3/day) Progress/Status: Waste Water treatment plant at Davangere (20 MLD+5 MLD), Harihara (18 MLD) and Byadgi (5 MLD) have been constructed to increase the sewage treatment capacity by 48 MLD. STP at Davangere has been completed, while the STPs at Harihara and Byadgi is under finishing work Data Source: • PPMS, KUIDFC, and ULB reports Actual value:

Output: Expanded and upgraded UWSS infrastructure in three towns of the Upper Tunga Bhadra subbasin Indicator: • Length of piped network added (additional 1,050km; baseline: 609km) Progress/Status: Work of water supply distribution network is under progress in Byadgi and Davangere and under operations in Harihara. 1,618 Km pipe line has been laid till date (exceeding the target). Data Source: • PPMS, KUIDFC, and ULB reports Actual value:

Output: Expanded and upgraded UWSS infrastructure in three towns of the Upper Tunga Bhadra subbasin Indicator: • Community water groups in three towns, with equal participation of women, formed to promote water conservation, hygiene, and sanitation Progress/Status: Community Water Groups (CWG) has been formed in all he three ULBS. Regular meetings are held with the CWGs to promote water conservation, hygiene, and sanitation. Women participation is highly encouraged. Data Source: • NGO reports Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y

Output: Improved water resource planning, monitoring, and service delivery Indicator: 2.2 State and ULB Reform Program implemented • ULB IT-based modules developed and piloted in four project towns Progress/Status: IT Module-1 & 2 has been 0perationalized on flat rate basis in 4 project towns..
Data Source: • KMRC web page and promotional materials Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y

Output: Improved water resource planning, monitoring, and service delivery Indicator: 2.3 Improved communication and citizen participation • Social and behavioral change programs conducted across three ULBs for community members, including women, men, and adolescent girls Progress/Status: Social & Behavioral Programs conducted (No.): Davanagere - 502 Harihara - 114 Byadgi - 108 Data Source: • PPMS and NGO reports Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y

Output: Improved water resource planning, monitoring, and service delivery Indicator: • IEC leaflets disseminated to spread awareness on gender equality, health, hygiene and sanitation prepared Progress/Status: IEC leaflets disseminated (No.): Davanagere - 80,000 Harihara - 19,656 Byadgi - 9,340 Data Source: • IEC materials Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y

Output: Improved water resource planning, monitoring, and service delivery Indicator: • State guidelines on public stand posts Progress/Status: To better manage service delivery of water services in urban local bodies (ULBs), the State Government has accorded approval of 7 reform guidelines/policies: (a) guidelines for regularizing unauthorized connections; (b) volumetric tariff determination model; (c) urban watershed management guidelines; (d) guidelines for strategy plan for urban drinking water demand management - public stand post policy; (e) guidelines for water safety plans; (f) monitoring and assessment framework for non-revenue water; and (g) water service charters. Data Source: • UDD circular instructions Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y

Output: Improved water resource planning, monitoring, and service delivery Indicator: • Water supply contracts with private sector participation mainstreamed (three project towns) Progress/Status: All the water supply subprojects are implemented using performance based construct and operator contract. Data Source: • PPMS, project contractual documents Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y

Output: Strengthened operational and administrative capacity of KUIDFC and ULBs Indicator: 3.1 Improved KUIDFC financial intermediation capacity • Business and financial strategy and plans developed, including capital adequacy, asset quality, liquidity, and profitability programs Progress/Status: The consultants team mobilized to assess financial intermediation capacity of KUIDFC, submitted revised “As-is report.” KUIDFC is reviewing the findings and preparing for the meetings with senior state officials to discuss options and obtain guidance about the way forward. After obtaining the State Government policy direction, the consultants would carry out focused institutional audit and prepare phase wise transition plan. Data Source: • PPMS, KUIDFC annual reports Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y

Output: Strengthened operational and administrative capacity of KUIDFC and ULBs Indicator: 3.3 Project management system operational • Project 1 implemented on time and within budget Progress/Status: Loan was fully utilized by the loan closing date of 30 Spetmeber 2020 Data Source: • PPMS and TPRM reviews Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y

Output: Strengthened operational and administrative capacity of KUIDFC and ULBs Indicator: • Credit and risk management policies, operating systems, and procedures developed Progress/Status: The consultants team mobilized to assess financial intermediation capacity of KUIDFC, submitted revised “As-is report.” KUIDFC is reviewing the findings and preparing for the meetings with senior state officials to discuss options and obtain guidance about the way forward. After obtaining the State Government policy direction, the consultants would carry out focused institutional audit and prepare phase wise transition plan. Data Source: • PPMS, KUIDFC annual reports Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y

Output: Strengthened operational and administrative capacity of KUIDFC and ULBs Indicator: • Procedures to assess and monitor the economic, social, gender equality, and environmental impact of subprojects approved Progress/Status: Economic, social, gender equality and environmental impact on the subprojects are being monitored and reported to ADB via safeguard and gender reports. Data Source: • PPMS, KUIDFC annual reports Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y

Output: Strengthened operational and administrative capacity of KUIDFC and ULBs Indicator: • Project MIS contains gender and social inclusion focused indicators. Sex - disaggregated data collected, analyzed, and key findings. Progress/Status: Project MIS with sex disaggregated data has been developed. Data Source: • PPMS Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y

Output: Strengthened operational and administrative capacity of KUIDFC and ULBs Indicator: • Workshops focusing on social and gender issues organized for KUIDFC, ULBs, PMU, PIU women and men staff Progress/Status: Workshops focusing on social and gender issues are being organized for KUIDFC, ULBs, PMU, PIU women and men staff Data Source: • PPMS, trainer records Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y
